title: Error Budget Lane Allocation and Initiative Sequencing for Reliability Runway
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Problem: We currently treat error budgets as a single pool per product line which leads to contention between platform reliability work (runtime/kernel improvements) and surface-level safety/UX reliability fixes. Goal: Define a lightweight "lanes" model that partitions error budget into lanes (Platform, Customer-facing, Canary/Experiment) and provide a prioritization/sequencing framework so we can schedule initiatives against specific lanes across the quarter. This ticket scopes the PM deliverables: lane definitions, a lane allocation matrix for Q3, a sequencing algorithm for initiative intake, and templates for handoff to eng/design. Deliverables: 1) Lane definitions doc with SLI mappings and burn-rate thresholds; 2) Allocation matrix spreadsheet for multi-tenant clusters; 3) Initiative sequencing rubric + intake form; 4) Dashboard view spec in Console to display lane-level burn and runway. Out of scope: changes to enforcement tooling or automated throttles (those will be follow-ups with ENG).
acceptance_criteria: Lane definitions published in Confluence with at least one representative SLI per lane
Q3 allocation matrix reviewed and approved by Reliability, Platform, and Product leads
Sequencing rubric codified into intake form used by PMs for reliability work
Dashboard mock in Console with lane-level burn visualization and projected runway
success_metrics: Reduction in cross-team priority conflicts measured by fewer escalation meetings (target: -50% vs Q1)
Observed alignment between planned vs executed initiatives for each lane (target: 80% match)
Time-to-approval for reliability initiatives drops from avg 9 days to <=3 days
rollout_plan: Week 1: Draft lane definitions and map current initiatives into lanes
Week 2: Review workshop with Reliability, Platform, and Customer Success; incorporate feedback
Week 3: Publish allocation matrix and intake form; pilot intake on 3 incoming initiatives
Week 4-8: Iterate based on pilot data; hand off dashboard spec to Console team and open ENG follow-ups for enforcement/tooling
Q3 Kickoff: Use lanes in quarterly planning and include lane capacity in roadmap syncs
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Teams may treat lanes as rigid quotas and under-prioritize urgent fixes. Mitigation: Add emergency override lane and define escalation path.
Risk: Measurement mismatch between SLIs used by lanes and what Console currently emits. Mitigation: Early alignment session with telemetry owners and temporary mapping layer in doc.
Risk: Overhead of maintaining allocation matrix. Mitigation: Keep allocations coarse-grained (monthly buckets) and automate refresh from SLO ledger in a follow-up ticket.
